# homeassistant_mqtt (Resource)

The config entry of the MQTT integration: the connection to an MQTT broker. Home Assistant allows only one. Changing the broker settings reconfigures the entry in place, and discovery and the birth and will messages are set through its options flow. Home Assistant cannot return the data or options an entry has, so they are never compared with Home Assistant; only an entry that is gone is detected as drift. After an import, the first apply only records the attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The connection to an MQTT broker over TLS. Home Assistant allows only one.
resource "homeassistant_mqtt" "broker" {
  broker   = "mqtt.home.local"
  port     = 8883
  username = "homeassistant"
  password = var.mqtt_password

  tls = {
    ca_certificate = file("${path.module}/ca.pem")
  }

  # Options: set through the options flow, without reconnecting.
  discovery_prefix = "homeassistant"
  birth_message    = { topic = "homeassistant/status", payload = "online", retain = true }
}

variable "mqtt_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `broker` (String) Host name or IP address of the broker.

### Optional

- `birth_message` (Attributes) Message Home Assistant publishes when it connects. Unset, Home Assistant's default is used: topic `homeassistant/status`, payload `online`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--birth_message))
- `client_id` (String) Client ID to connect with. Unset, the MQTT client picks a random one.
- `discovery` (Boolean) Whether MQTT discovery is on. Defaults to `true`.
- `discovery_prefix` (String) Topic prefix of MQTT discovery. Defaults to `homeassistant`.
- `keepalive` (Number) Seconds between keepalive messages, at least 15. Defaults to `60`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password to log in to the broker. Removing it replaces the entry, because a reconfigure keeps the old password when none is given.
- `port` (Number) Port of the broker. Defaults to `1883`.
- `protocol` (String) MQTT protocol version: `3.1`, `3.1.1` or `5`. Defaults to `3.1.1`.
- `tls` (Attributes) Connect with TLS. Unset, the connection is not encrypted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tls))
- `transport` (String) Transport: `tcp` or `websockets`. Defaults to `tcp`.
- `username` (String) User name to log in to the broker.
- `will_message` (Attributes) Message the broker publishes when Home Assistant disconnects. Unset, Home Assistant's default is used: topic `homeassistant/status`, payload `offline`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--will_message))
- `ws_headers` (Map of String) Extra HTTP headers of the WebSocket connection, only with `transport = "websockets"`.
- `ws_path` (String) WebSocket path, only with `transport = "websockets"`. Unset, Home Assistant uses `/`.

### Read-Only

- `disabled_by` (String) Who disabled the config entry, e.g. `user`; null if it is enabled.
- `id` (String) The config entry's `entry_id`, assigned by Home Assistant. Import with this ID.
- `state` (String) State of the config entry when it was last read, e.g. `loaded` or `setup_error`.
- `title` (String) Title of the config entry, chosen by the integration.

<a id="nestedatt--birth_message"></a>
### Nested Schema for `birth_message`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the message is sent. Defaults to `true`.
- `payload` (String) Payload. Defaults to `online`.
- `qos` (Number) Quality of service: 0, 1 or 2. Defaults to `0`.
- `retain` (Boolean) Whether the broker retains the message. Defaults to `false`.
- `topic` (String) Topic. Defaults to `homeassistant/status`.


<a id="nestedatt--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tls`

Optional:

- `ca_certificate` (String) PEM certificate of the CA that signed the broker's certificate, e.g. `file("ca.pem")`. Unset, the system's CAs are trusted.
- `client_certificate` (String) PEM client certificate to log in with. Requires `client_key`.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM private key of `client_certificate`, not encrypted.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Do not check that the broker's certificate matches `broker`. Defaults to `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--will_message"></a>
### Nested Schema for `will_message`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the message is sent. Defaults to `true`.
- `payload` (String) Payload. Defaults to `offline`.
- `qos` (Number) Quality of service: 0, 1 or 2. Defaults to `0`.
- `retain` (Boolean) Whether the broker retains the message. Defaults to `false`.
- `topic` (String) Topic. Defaults to `homeassistant/status`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the MQTT config entry by its entry_id. The inputs cannot be read back: write them into
# the configuration afterwards, and the next apply records them without touching the entry.
tofu import homeassistant_mqtt.broker 01JABCDEF0123456789ABCDEFG
```
